English Language.question: ১) Barishal is _______ Hog plum growing areas in Bangladesh.
English Language.exp: One of থাকলে superlative degree-র পূর্বে the বসে । সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে - Barishal is one of the largest Hog plum growing areas in Bangladesh.

English Language.question: ২) It is 11.25 am now. The sun _______ in the eastern sky.
English Language.exp: বাক্যের অর্থ হবে - এখন এগারোটা পঁচিশ বাজে। পূবের আকাশে সূর‌্য জ্বলজ্বল করছে । বাক্যের context থেকে বুঝা যাচ্ছে verb এর continuous form হবে । সুতরাং শূন্যস্থানে Is shining হবে।

English Language.question: ৩) The comparative form of ‘ill’ is-
English Language.exp: ill, bad, evil শব্দগুলোর comparative form হচ্ছে worse এবং superlative form হচ্ছে worst.

English Language.question: ৪) What is the plural number of ‘ovum’-
English Language.exp: ‘Ovum’ is a singular number. সাধারণত singular number এর শেষে um থাকলে plural করার সময় um কে a দ্বারা পরিবর্তন করতে হয়। The plural number of ‘ovum’ is ‘ova’ অর্থ ডিম্বানু।

English Language.question: ৫) A Compound sentence has-
English Language.option1: ক) a subject and a finite verb
English Language.option2: খ) two or more co-ordinate clauses
English Language.option3: গ) two or more sub-ordinate clauses
English Language.option4: ঘ) one principle clause and one sub-ordinate clause
English Language.exp: Compound sentence এ দুই বা ততোধিক principal clause বা co-ordinate clause থাকে।

English Language.question: ৬) Choose the word which never has a plural form?
English Language.exp:
এমন কতগুলো uncountable noun আছে যেগুলো সর্বদাই singular number রূপে ব্যবহৃত হয়।
যেমন: Abuse, advice, alphabet, Bread, Furniture, issue, Knowledge, information, poetry scenery ইত্যাদি।

English Language.question: ৭) ‘He is poor but honest’ find the complex form-
English Language.option1: ক) He being poor is honest.
English Language.option2: খ) Inspite of his honesty he is poor.
English Language.option3: গ) Despite his poverty he is honest.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Although he is poor he is honest.
English Language.exp: Compound sentence এ But থাকলে Complex sentence এর ক্ষেত্রে Though/although ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Language.question: ৮) Which one is an all-time masculine gender?
English Language.exp: Amazon, shrew এবং siren হচ্ছে all-time feminine gender. Parson (পাদ্রী) হচ্ছে all-time masculine gender.

English Language.question: ৯) Plural form of ‘Goose’ is-
English Language.exp: কতগুলো noun আছে যেগুলোর vowel পরিবর্তন করে plural করতে হয়। যেমন, tooth-teeth, foot-feet, man-men, Goose-Geese ইত্যাদি।

English Language.question: ১০) Use the right tense: Ratul _____ for a new room-mate before he finally succeeded.
English Language.exp: অতীতের দুটি ক্রমিক ঘটনার ক্ষেত্রে একটির আগে অন্যটি চলছিল এরূপ বুঝাতে চলমান কাজটি হয় past perfect Continuous এবং অন্যটি হয় past Indefinite । সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে - Ratul had been looking for a new room-mate before he finally succeeded.

English Language.question: ১১) Which one is not singular?
English Language.exp: কতগুলো noun আছে যেগুলো দেখতে plural মনে হলেও সেগুলো আসলে singular. যেমন, Ethics, Economics, Electronics, mathematics, politics, physics, news.

English Language.question: ১২) The Jamuna is one of the biggest rivers in Bangladesh.(positive)
English Language.option1: ক) Very few river in Bangladesh is as big as the Jamuna.
English Language.option2: খ) Very few rivers in Bangladesh are as big as the Jamuna.
English Language.option3: গ) No other river in Bangladesh is as big as the Jamuna.
English Language.option4: ঘ) No other rivers in Bangladesh are as big as the Jamuna.
English Language.exp:
Superlative degree তে one of the থাকলে positive degree তে very few হয়।
Structure : very few + plural noun + plural verb + as + positive degree + as + subject.

English Language.question: ১৩) What is the singular form of ‘Corps’?
English Language.exp: এমন কতগুলো শব্দ আছে যেগুলোর singular form and plural form একই রকম। যেমন: deer, sheep, swine, pice, cannon, corps, offspring, series, aircraft, dozen, hundred, salmon, public ইত্যাদি।

English Language.question: ১৪) You must work hard for success. Make it compound-
English Language.option1: ক) Work hard for the success.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Work hard and you will succeed.
English Language.exp: Compound sentence এ সাধারণত দুইটি principle clause and, or, but, else, yet, otherwise, therefore ইত্যাদি conjunction দ্বারা যুক্ত থাকে।

English Language.question: ১৫) ‘I saw that she was dancing.’ (Simple)
English Language.option1: ক) I saw her to dance.
English Language.option3: গ) I saw her being dancing.
English Language.exp: Structure: Sub + saw + someone + verb + ing

English Language.question: ১৬) Which one is plural?
English Language.exp: কতগুলো noun আছে যেগুলো শুধু plural হয়। যেমন, alms, amends, annals, ashes, belongings, bowels/entrails, environs, fetters, thanks, vitals, savings, eaves ইত্যাদি ।

English Language.question: ১৭) I know him better than you. Make it positive-
English Language.option1: ক) You do not know him as good as I know.
English Language.option2: খ) You do not know him as good as me.
English Language.option3: গ) You do not know him as well as me.
English Language.option4: ঘ) You do not know him as well as I know.
English Language.exp: Good/well এর comparative এবং superlative degree যথাক্রমে better/best. বাক্যের গঠন এবং যথাযথ অর্থবিচারে ‘You do not know him as well as I know.’ সঠিক উত্তর।

English Language.question: ১৮) What is the plural form of ‘it’?
English Language.exp: ‘They’ is the plural form of it, he and she. ‘These’ is the plural form of this. ‘Those’ is the plural form of that.

English Language.question: ১৯) He acted on my advice. Make it complex-
English Language.option1: ক) I advised him that he acted.
English Language.option2: খ) He acted according to my advice.
English Language.option3: গ) He acted as I advised him.
English Language.exp:
Simple sentence: He acted on my advice.
Complex sentence: He acted as I advised him.
Complex sentence এর গঠন অনুসারে ‘He acted as I advised him.’ সঠিক উত্তর হবে।

English Language.question: ২০) ‘Jumping up he ran away.’ This sentence is-
English Language.exp: একটি মাত্র subject এবং একটি মাত্র finite verb নিয়ে Simple sentence গঠিত হয়। প্রদত্ত বাক্যে ‘he’ হলো বাক্যের Subject এবং ‘run away’ হলো finite verb. সুতরাং ‘Jumping up he ran away.’ একটি Simple sentence.

English Language.question: ২১) ‘I know what his name is’ - is a _________ sentence.
English Language.exp: Complex sentence এ who, which, that, what ইত্যাদি relative pronoun দ্বারা দুটি clause যুক্ত থাকে। প্রদত্ত বাক্যে ‘I know’ এবং ‘his name is’ হলো দুটি clause যা what দ্বারা যুক্ত রয়েছে । তাই এটি complex sentence.

English Language.question: ২২) The plural form of ‘Apex’ is-
English Language.exp: According to the rules of Number, if a singular number word ends with ix/ex, there will need ‘es’ or ‘ices’ to make it plural.

English Language.question: ২৩) Which one is singular?
English Language.exp:
There are some words which are always plural.
Such as- alms, amends, ashes, bowels, fetters, savings, scissors, spectacles, surroundings.
বিভিন্ন খেলার নাম যেমনঃ darts, Billiards, Draughts Dominoes Bowls ইত্যাদি Singular হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Language.question: ২৪) Identify the word that can be used as both singular and plural.
English Language.exp: ‘সমষ্টিগতভাবে’ বুঝালে fish-এর plural form ‘fish’-ই হয়। তবে ‘ভিন্নজাতীয়’ বুঝালে fish-এর plural form হয় ‘fishes’।

English Language.question: ২৫) Which one is plural?
English Language.exp:
Brother শব্দের একই ধর্মের সদস্য অর্থে plural = brethren.
অন্যান্য শব্দের plural-
Ovum = ova
Curriculum = Curricula
Aquarium = aquaria/aquariums

English Language.question: ২৬) He had his hair _____.
English Language.exp: Had + something + verb এর Past participle। ‘cut’ –এর Past participle হচ্ছে cut.

English Language.question: ২৭) Which one is plural number?
English Language.exp:
Nebulae হচ্ছে plural form of Nebula.
Plural form of others words:
Quantum = Quanta
Maximum = Maxima
Criterion = Criteria

English Language.question: ২৮) Which one is used as common gender?
English Language.exp:
Spouse = A husband or wife, considered in relation to their partner.
Masculine and Feminine form of the other words:
Bachelor – spinster
Emperor – Empress
Comedian – comedienne

English Language.question: ২৯) The female of a horse is called?
English Language.exp: The female of a horse or stallion (ঘোড়া) is called a mare (ঘোটকী)

English Language.question: ৩০) Find out the masculine gender.
English Language.exp: অপশনগুলোতে ‘Drone’ (পুরুষ মৌমাছি) হচ্ছে masculine gender। এর feminine gender হবে Bee (স্ত্রী মৌমাছি)। Witch, Mare এবং Nun এর Masculine gender হবে যথাক্রমে wizard, horse/stallion এবং Monk/friar.

English Language.question: ৩১) The plural form of the word ‘Radius’-
English Language.exp: Radius (ব্যাসার্ধ) শব্দটি singular. এর plural form হবে radii or radiuses.

English Language.question: ৩২) The plural form of ‘Hypothesis’ is-
English Language.exp: Hypothesis (অনুমান) শব্দটি singular. এর plural form হবে Hypotheses.

English Language.question: ৩৩) The plural form of ‘sheep’ is-
English Language.exp:
কতগুলো শব্দ আছে যাদের singular এবং plural form একই রকম হয়ে থাকে।
যেমন- sheep, dear, score, swine, cannon, corps, offspring, series, carp, cod, pair, dozen, species, Aircraft, Hovercraft, spacecraft, dice, public, pair, pike, Gross, hundred, thousand, Million ইত্যাদি।

English Language.question: ৩৪) ‘He was too weak to walk’ (make it Compound).
English Language.option1: ক) He is very weak to walk.
English Language.option2: খ) He was very weak and walk.
English Language.option3: গ) He is so weak to walk.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He was very weak and could not walk
English Language.exp:
Simple sentence এ too + adjective + to + verb থাকলে Compound এ too এর স্থলে very এবং that এর স্থলে and বসে।
Simple sentence: He was too weak to walk
Compound sentence: He was very weak and could not walk

English Language.question: ৩৫) Onion prices have _____ too much this month.
English Language.exp: মূল্য বা তাপমাত্রা বৃদ্ধি বুঝাতে ‘rise’ ব্যবহৃত হয়। বাক্যটি present perfect Tense. ‘rise’ এর past participle form হচ্ছে ‘risen’.

English Language.question: ৩৬) Correct sentence of the following is-
English Language.option1: ক) A pair of pants are in the drawer.
English Language.option2: খ) This pair of scissors is dull.
English Language.option3: গ) This pair of scissors are dull.
English Language.exp: Pants, scissors, jeans, trousers are always considered as plural and the verb should also be plural. In order to use them as singular, ‘a pair of’ must be added and then the verb will be singular.

English Language.question: ৩৭) Which one of the following is not a common gender?
English Language.exp: Emperor এর feminine gender হচ্ছে Empress।

English Language.question: ৩৮) Raju is the best player in the team. (Comparative)
English Language.option1: ক) Very few players in the team are as good as Raju.
English Language.option2: খ) Raju is a good player in the class.
English Language.option3: গ) Raju is better than any other player in the team.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Raju is better than any other players in the team.
English Language.exp: Structure of Comparative sentence : Sub + be verb + Comparative form + than any other + বাকি অংশ।

English Language.question: ৩৯) Choose the correct sentence.
English Language.option1: ক) Less people get British visas nowadays.
English Language.option2: খ) Least people get British visas nowadays.
English Language.option3: গ) Few people get British visas nowadays.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Fewer people get British visas nowadays.
English Language.exp: Little এর comparative degree হচ্ছে less এবং few এর comparative degree হচ্ছে Fewer. Uncountable noun এর আগে less এবং Countable এর আগে Fewer বসে ‘তুলনামূলক কম’ অর্থ প্রদান করে।

English Language.question: ৪০) Write down the correct sentence:
English Language.option1: ক) Tell me why have you come here.
English Language.option2: খ) What time did you go to bed last night?
English Language.option3: গ) Why you are angry with me.
English Language.option4: ঘ) When you passed your diploma Examination.
English Language.exp: Last night সময় নির্দেশক adverb যা বাক্যে past indefinite নির্দেশ করে। past indefinite tense এর সঠিক Interrogative বাক্য ‘What time did you go to bed last night?’.

English Language.question: ৪১) Which one is incorrect?
English Language.exp: The correct pair is ‘Bridegroom — Bride’

English Language.question: ৪২) Which one is not plural?
English Language.exp: কতগুলো শব্দ আছে যেগুলো সর্বদাই plural হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়। যেমন-poultry, Vermin, aristocracy, Gentry ইত্যাদি।

English Language.question: ৪৩) Which one’s singular and plural form are same?
English Language.exp:
Plural form of ‘Canon’ is ‘Canon’.
But the singular and plural form of ‘Cannon’ are 'Cannon/Cannons' both.

On the other hand,
The plural form of 'Chassis' is 'Chassis'.
So, Chassis is the right answer.

English Language.question: ৪৪) The greater the demand, _____ the price.
English Language.exp:
সমানুপাতিক বৃদ্ধি বা হৃাসের ক্ষেত্রে parallelism নীতি অনুসরন করতে হয়।
The + comparative degree …..the Comparative degree হয়। সুতরাং, ‘The greater the demand, the higher the price’ হবে।

English Language.question: ৪৫) He is so dishonest that he cannot speak the truth.(simple)
English Language.option1: ক) He is too dishonest that he cannot speak the truth.
English Language.option2: খ) He is too dishonest to be spoken the truth.
English Language.option3: গ) He is too dishonest to speak the truth.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He is very dishonest and cannot speak the truth.
English Language.exp: ‘too…..to’ অর্থ হচ্ছে ‘এতই যে…..না’। `He is too dishonest to speak the truth’ - বাক্যটির অর্থ হচ্ছে, ‘লোকটি এতই অসৎ যে সে সত্য কথা বলে না।’

English Language.question: ৪৬) ‘A rolling stone gathers no moss’ the complex form of the sentence is-
English Language.option1: ক) Since a stone is rolling, it gathers no moss.
English Language.option2: খ) Though a stone rolls, it gathers no moss.
English Language.option3: গ) A stone what rolls gathers no moss.
English Language.option4: ঘ) A stone that rolls gathers no moss.
English Language.exp: Compex sentence contains one principle clause and one or more subordinate clause. A rolling stone কে compex এ লেখা যায় a stone that (relative pronoun হিসেবে that বসবে) rolls gathers no moss.

English Language.question: ৪৭) I wish if I _________ a politician.
English Language.exp: বাক্যে as, if, though, wish এরপর to be verb আসলে তা সব সময় were হবে। অন্য কোন verb আসলে তার past tense হয়।

English Language.question: ৪৮) He seized the opportunity as soon as it ________ itself.
English Language.exp: কোন বাক্যে Yesterday, ago, long ago, long since, last, last night, last week, last month, last year, the day before yesterday, as soon as ইত্যাদি শব্দগুচ্ছ থাকলে past indefinite tense নির্দেশ করে।

English Language.question: ৪৯) Each of the football players _________ for months, even years.
English Language.exp: বাক্যটিতে for months, even years থাকায় তা present perfect continuous tense হবে। আর বাক্যের শুরুতে each থাকায় verb singular হবে। সঠিক উত্তর- has been training হবে।

English Language.question: ৫০) Which sentence is correct?
English Language.option1: ক) This is an unique case
English Language.option2: খ) This is a unique case
English Language.option3: গ) This is a very unique case
English Language.option4: ঘ) This is the most unique case
English Language.exp: কতগুলো শব্দ আছে যেগুলো superlative এর অর্থ প্রদান করে। যেমন absolute, almighty, chief, complete, daily, entire, excellent, perfect, supreme, unique ইত্যাদি। তাই এগুলোর পূর্বে more, most, very বা অন্যকোন qualifier বসে না। অন্যদিকে unique এর উচ্চারণ ইউনিক তাই এর পূর্বে an না বসে a বসবে।
